- Finance/Rev Ops (Neha): confirm revenue recognition class and whether we need invoice hold/wiring instructions to appear on the PO.
- Contracts (Priyom): are there any SLA exceptions still open? If yes, list them and owner.

Attachments: eoq_commit_matrix_v3.xlsx (matrix with stages/owners), acme_po_template.pdf (vendor PO template).

- PO: ACME committed verbally to issue PO today; they will use acme_po_template.pdf. Harper from FinOps verified wiring instructions and said finance will accept the 30-day net term requested.
- Technical: Marissa confirmed Dedicated cluster reserved for the November go-live and provided initial runbook on the shared Drive.

Net result: ACME moved from "Awaiting Internal Legal Approval" -> "Closed - Committed". Revenue impact: first-year ARR add ~ $1.2M (refer to revenue-impact-summary.png).

Final asks: 
- David: confirm when DocuSign returns executed copy so we can record in HubSpot and kick billing.
- Neha: if ACME lands PO by EOD tomorrow, please prepare the invoice draft and tagging so we can accelerate recognition next week.
- All: update the matrix (eoq_commit_matrix_v3.xlsx) with final statuses and owners.

Thanks everyone for swift responses in the bridge. I'll close the ticket in the pipeline and add the notes to the EOQ rollup.

Best —
